goal.insight: Show the complete deployment pipeline from dev through staging, canary, and production environments, making the sequential progression and branching decision points visually prominent
Highlight all automatic rollback paths that can trigger when health checks or error-rate thresholds fail, visually distinguishing them from the forward deployment flow
Emphasize the blue-green traffic switching logic at the production stage, showing how traffic shifts between active and standby slots and the decision gate that governs the cutover
Mark the HPA scaling decision checkpoints at each environment stage, showing the CPU/memory thresholds that trigger scale-up or scale-down actions
Use swimlane-style separation so that each environment (dev, staging, canary, production) occupies a distinct visual lane, making cross-environment transitions and parallel activities easy to trace
